name: sodium-tracker
description: The **Sodium Tracker** application is a serverless, mobile-first web app designed to monitor, calculate, and log daily sodium consumption. Key capabilities include a flexible unit portion calculator (supporting both 100g and 100ml baselines), manual and AI-assisted web lookups, local user management with encrypted authentication, a pre-check consumption warning system, multi-unit food intake logging (count, grams, or milliliters), and a hybrid private/shared food catalog equipped with image support and local fuzzy search.
